translations.3★/4★ 角色的 UR 专用装备算爛装；5★ 角色的永远保留。: UR Exclusive Gear of 3★/4★ Characters counts as junk gear; 5★ Characters' is always kept.
translations.{month} 月 · 点一天看要卖什么: Month {month} · click a day to see what to sell
translations.{name} · 点一下设定跑不跑这张: {name} · click to choose whether to run this Pack
translations.整次最多处理几件（黄色!新装备、R、SR 和 N 装备都算在内），1~10 件。: Max Gear handled in one run (new Gear with the yellow !, R, SR and the N Gear all count), 1~10.
translations.一次运行最多进行的战斗场数（0 表示用完可用AP）。: Max battles per run (0 means use all available AP).
translations.一键运行会照左边的顺序跑 {n} 项 · 今天做完 {done} 项: Run All runs {n} items in the order on the left · {done} done today
translations.一键运行会照左边的顺序跑 {n} 项 · 本周做完 {done} 项: Run All runs {n} items in the order on the left · {done} done this week
translations.一项失败后继续跑后面的: Keep running the rest if one fails
translations.主页卡带 → 末日之书 → 走到红色交叉剑标记 → 去战斗 → 跳过 → 离开: Packs on Home → Last Night → walk to the red crossed-swords marker → Go to battle → Skip → Leave → back to Home (Weekly Quest: Take part in Last Night). The battle costs no resources. It moves the way Mirror Wars' "Stage movement" setting says.
translations.主页右侧活动横幅上的文字，逗号分隔，命中任意一个即点击。: Text on the Event banner on the right side of Home, comma-separated. Clicks it if any one matches.
translations.今天的日常都做完了: All Dailies are done for today
translations.从主页进入公会，领取每日签到奖励。: Enters the Guild from Home and claims the daily Check-in reward.
translations.从主页进入小屋，确认到达后返回主页。: Enters the House from Home, confirms it arrived, then returns to Home.
translations.从快速切换页的生活玩法游戏卡带2号位进入梦幻广场并完成女神像许愿。: Enters Fantasia Square from Content Pack slot 2 on the Quick Switch page and makes a wish at the Goddess Statue.
translations.从首页进入快速狩猎，调度米饭并补充数量最少的属性圣石。: Enters Quick Hunt from Home, allocates Cooked rice and tops up the Magic Crystals you have the fewest of.
translations.消耗免费米饭和火把：米饭全部打冒险航线（不打狩猎场），火把打圣石洞穴。: Uses free Cooked Rice and Torches: all rice goes to the Path of Adventure (no Hunting Ground), torches go to the Sacred Stone Cave.
translations.优先双倍：打有双倍的冒险航线（都双倍或都没有时，打资源倾向的航线）；忽视双倍：不: Prefer double: runs the Path of Adventure that has double (if both or neither do, the preferred resource's route). Ignore double: ignores double and always runs the Gold route (for late-game players with Slime/EXP to spare).
translations.优先双倍时两条都双倍或都没有双倍，就打这条航线。: Under Prefer double, this route is run when both routes or neither route has double.
translations.依次打开左侧有红点的通行证，每张点一次全部获得（绝不点购买）。: Opens each Pass with a red mark on the left and taps Claim All once on each (never Buy).
translations.全部做完后自动关机: Shut down when everything is done
translations.关掉后只能在这里单独跑: When off, it can only be run on its own here
translations.出问题时把这里的档案传给开发者: If something goes wrong, send the files here to the developer
translations.到「日常设定」把要跑的项目加进一键日常: Add the items to run to Run All Dailies in "Daily Setup"
translations.制作几件 N 装备（1~10）。: How many N Gear to craft (1~10).
translations.制作后强化到的等级，达到后游戏自动分解。: Level to Upgrade to after crafting; the game dismantles it automatically once reached.
translations.单独跑时不会做事；一键运行不受影响: Does nothing when run on its own; Run All is not affected
translations.单独跑时启用: Enable when run on its own
translations.只用每日免费活动AP（顶部 a/5），不动用额外的 +AP。: Uses only the daily free Event AP (a/5 at the top), never the extra +AP.
translations.同时领取商品邮箱（购买的礼包等）。: Also claims Purchase mail (bought bundles, etc.).
translations.我的小屋 → 参观 → 随机，给其他玩家的小屋点赞（每周任务：增加人气 3 次）: My House → Visit → Random, likes other players' Houses (Weekly Quest: Raise Popularity 3 times).
translations.打开主页的街机游戏菜单再返回（每周任务：浏览街机游戏菜单）。不玩小游戏。: Opens the Arcade menu on Home and goes back (Weekly Quest: Browse the Arcade menu). Doesn't play minigames.
translations.打开任务页，一键领取每日任务与每周任务的全部奖励。: Opens the Quests page and claims all Daily Quest and Weekly Quest rewards at once.
translations.打开经营管理弹窗并执行一键获得。: Opens the Management popup and runs Collect All.
translations.打开邮箱，一键领取普通邮箱（可选商品邮箱）的全部邮件。: Opens the Mailbox and claims all General mail (and optionally Purchase mail) at once.
translations.换了之后重新打开工具才会生效: Takes effect after you reopen the tool
translations.开启后，SR 不点开，和 R 一样直接分解；关闭时点开核对，5★ 角色的保留（默: When on, SR is dismantled without opening it, like R; when off it is opened and checked, and 5★ Characters' is kept (default).
translations.普通与挑战都已通关时，对挑战战斗15使用快速战斗。: When Normal and Challenge are both cleared, uses Quick Battle on Challenge Battle 15.
translations.每周一 08:00 重新开始 · 每张卡带一周跑一次: Resets every Mon 08:00 · each Pack runs once a week
translations.每场战斗消耗的免费鲜血鸡尾酒倍数，1~40。每天有 40 杯免费鸡尾酒，例如 1: Free Blood Cocktail multiplier per battle, 1~40. You get 40 free Blood Cocktails a day; for example, 10x for 4 battles uses them all. Drops to 1 temporarily when AP is short.
translations.每天一次：买 → 做料理 → 卖: Once a day: Buy → Cook → Sell
translations.游戏开着但还在登录画面时，自动点进主页: When the game is open but still on the login screen, taps through to Home
translations.游戏开着时，选好大小按「调整」: With the game open, pick a size and press "Resize"
translations.游戏设置为点击移动时选「鼠标点击舞台」；用 WASD 移动的玩家选「键盘WASD: If the game is set to click-to-move, choose "Click to stage"; players who move with WASD choose "Walk to stage with WASD". Last Night uses this setting too to reach the red battle marker, and tries the other way if it can't get there.
translations.点卡带设定这次跑不跑它: Click a Pack to choose whether to run it this time
translations.点赞未生效（如已点过）时换下一间，最多翻看这么多间后停止。: If a like doesn't go through (e.g. already liked), moves to the next House; stops after visiting this many.
translations.点选才做: Only the selected ones are made
translations.爛装强化到的等级，达到后游戏自动分解。: Level to Upgrade junk gear to; the game dismantles it automatically once reached.
translations.现在 {size}，选好大小按「调整」: Now {size}; pick a size and press "Resize"
translations.第一次跑，跑完就知道要多久: First run; you'll know how long it takes once it's done
translations.经营管理 → 前往格鲁菲餐厅 → 点「常客」一次领取常客带来的圣石。: Management → Go to Glupy Diner → tap "Regulars" once to claim the Magic Crystals your regulars brought.
translations.结算页的图和诊断截图都在这里: Result images and diagnostic screenshots are all here
translations.背包装备中挑一件精炼值低于24的装备精炼一次（活动任务：装备精炼）。只点「精炼」: Picks a Gear in your inventory with a Refine value under 24 and Refines it once (Event quest: Gear Refine). Only taps "Refine", never "Continuous Refine".
translations.自动战斗的场数；MAX（默认）用完当天的免费鸡尾酒。开打前会核对「战斗开始」上的: Number of auto battles; MAX (default) uses up the day's free Blood Cocktails. Before fighting, it checks that the cost on "Battle Start" = multiplier × battles, that it doesn't exceed the free Blood Cocktails shown at the top, and that "Use free Blood Cocktails only" is on; otherwise it cancels.
translations.跑完会在这里看到结果: Results show up here after a run
translations.这天没有要卖的: Nothing to sell on this day
translations.进入当期活动：普通战斗→挑战战斗用自动战斗推进未通关关卡；两种都通关后对挑战战斗: Enters the current Event: clears uncleared stages with auto battle, Normal Battle → Challenge Battle; once both are cleared, uses Quick Battle on Challenge Battle 15. Never taps Refill AP.
translations.选一项，设定好后按开始: Pick one, set it up, then press Start
translations.领取服装和装备的所有免费抽抽乐。: Claims all free Costume and Gear Draws.
translations.领完每日任务后切到每周任务页再领取一次。: After claiming Daily Quests, switches to the Weekly Quests tab and claims again.
translations.上次在「{name}」手动停止，做完的不会再跑: Stopped by hand at {name} last time; finished items won't run again
translations.按继续会从「{name}」接着跑，做完的不会再跑: Continue picks up from {name}; finished items won't run again
translations.在魔兽战的排位画面（BATTLE 显示 TURN）按开始: Press Start on the Fiend battle formation screen (BATTLE shows TURN)
translations.每个人的技能和爆发都照存档选。开打前：队伍组得跟录的时候一样，服装技能要齐，SP: Everyone's skill and Burst follow the save. Before you start: the team must match the recording, every Costume skill must be there, and you need enough SP
translations.先在游戏的「服装顺序设置」排好每个角色的服装顺序！工具只排出手顺序和站位，召唤物: First set each Character's Costume order in the game's Costume order settings! The tool only sets the turn order and positions; summons' skills follow the save
translations.名字不能空白，也不能有 \\ / : * ? \" < > |: The name can't be blank or contain \ / : * ? " < > |
translations.存档「{save}」的第 {n} 回合和它的截图会被删除，不能复原。: Turn {n} of the save {save} and its screenshot will be deleted. This can't be undone.
translations.还没有存档：按「新增」建一个，再按「录制」: No saves yet: press New to make one, then Start recording
translations.推荐先自己用 F8 录一场，之后回放最快最稳。下面有使用说明。: Best: record one fight yourself with F8 first; replays are then fastest and steadiest. The guide is below.
translations.自己录的存档：照每回合的站位、顺序和技能回放: Your own recording: replays each turn's positions, order and skills
translations.只有截图：照截图排位，打完一场自动存成动作档: Screenshots only: places units as the screenshots show, then saves an action file after the fight
translations.还没有回合：在排位画面按「录制」开始录: No turns yet: press Start recording on the formation screen
translations.设置没存上，请再点一次: The setting wasn't saved; click again
translations.勾了每回合逐个确认站位，较慢: When on, positions are checked one by one each turn (slower)
translations.只有截图时，打完存一份动作档: Screenshots only: save an action file after the fight
translations.下次照它回放，更快更稳: Replays from it next time are faster and steadier
translations.录制中：每回合排好后按 {key}，工具照右下角的回合数存: Recording: press {key} after setting up each turn; it's saved under the turn number at the bottom right
translations.录制：每回合排好后按 {key}，照右下角的回合数自动新增（录过的回合会覆盖）: Record: press {key} after setting up each turn; it's added under the turn number at the bottom right (a turn recorded before is overwritten)
translations.取个名字，例如 10月魔兽: Give it a name, e.g. October Fiend
translations.在游戏的魔兽战排位画面，先按工具上的「开始录制」: On the game's Fiend battle formation screen, first press Start recording in the tool
translations.每回合排好后按录制按键（默认 F8），不用按 BATTLE: After setting up each turn, press the record key (F8 by default); no need to press BATTLE
translations.打的时候不要动鼠标和键盘: Don't touch the mouse or keyboard while it fights
translations.在任一回合的排位画面再点「开始打」，接着打，不用从头: Press Start fight again on any turn's formation screen to carry on; no need to start over
translations.排好这回合后，在这个画面按 F8: After setting up the turn, press F8 on this screen
translations.拖动头像换格子: Drag a portrait to change cells
translations.点一下改攻击、技能或爆发: Click to change Attack, Skill or Burst
translations.这一队没有召唤物，技能交给游戏的服装顺序: This team has no summons; skills follow the game's Costume order
translations.点一个人改技能和爆发，拖动改顺序和站位，改完自动存: Click a unit to change its skill and Burst; drag to change order and cells. Saved automatically
translations.拖动改顺序和站位，点召唤物改技能，改完自动存: Drag to change order and cells; click a summon to change its skill. Saved automatically
translations.TEAM{team} · {n}/{max} 个角色 · 点头像移出，点下面的角: TEAM{team} · {n}/{max} Characters · click a portrait to remove, a Character below to add
translations.{name} 已在 TEAM{n}：先从那一队移出: {name} is already in TEAM{n}: remove them from that team first
translations.一队最多 {n} 个角色：先移出一个: A team holds up to {n} Characters: remove one first
translations.工具会把这次的情况和卡住时的游戏画面整理好，复制后贴到留言区，作者就知道卡在哪。: The tool puts together what happened this run and the game screen where it got stuck. Copy it and paste it in a comment so the author can see where it stopped.
translations.复制后到留言区或聊天框按 Ctrl+V 贴上。不含账号和电脑用户名: After copying, press Ctrl+V in a comment or chat box to paste. No account or PC user name is included
translations.图片已复制，到留言区或聊天框按 Ctrl+V 贴上: Image copied; press Ctrl+V in a comment or chat box to paste
translations.文字已复制，到留言区或聊天框按 Ctrl+V 贴上: Text copied; press Ctrl+V in a comment or chat box to paste
translations.选一次运行，复制图片或文字，到留言区或聊天框按 Ctrl+V 贴上。没失败但觉得: Pick a run, copy the image or text, and press Ctrl+V in a comment or chat box. Fine to use even if nothing failed but something felt off.
translations.跑过一键日常、周常或单独执行后，这里就能复制那一次的情况。: After Run All Dailies, Weeklies or a single run, you can copy what happened here.
translations.到「任务设定」把要跑的项目加进一键日常: Add the items to run to Run All Dailies in "Task Setup"
translations.打开启动器或工具后自动开始一键日常，只跑今天还没做的；游戏没开会自己打开并登录: When the launcher or tool opens, Run All Dailies starts by itself and only runs what is left today; if the game is not open, it opens it and logs in
translations.按 {pause} 暂停、{stop} 停止，可在设置里改: Press {pause} to pause, {stop} to stop (change them in Settings)
translations.跑的时候按一下暂停，再按一下继续: Press while running to pause, press again to resume
translations.跑过会自动取消勾选，每周{weekday} {time} 自动勾回来: Unticked once it runs; ticked again every {weekday} {time}
translations.魔兽追踪者录制时，每回合排好后按这个键: While recording Fiend Hunter, press this after arranging each turn
translations.游戏语言是繁体中文，工具目前只认得简体中文，所以认不出画面。请到游戏设置把语言改: The game language is Traditional Chinese. The tool only reads Simplified Chinese for now, so it can't recognise the screen. Switch the game language to Simplified Chinese in the game settings, then run again.
translations.到第一章商人处：砍价 → 关闭商店，重复设定的次数，不买东西。: At the Chapter 1 merchant: Bargain → close the shop, repeated the set number of times; buys nothing.
translations.找商人 → 砍价 → 关闭商店 算一次；砍价技能要升星时提前停下。: Find merchant → Bargain → close shop counts as one; stops early when the Bargain skill needs a star-up.
translations.砍价技能到传说或出现升星提示时会自动停下，但这点还没实测过，建议自己留意，以免浪: Stops by itself once the Bargain skill is Legendary or the game asks for a star-up. This has not been tested in the game yet, so keep an eye on it to avoid wasting resources.
translations.最好先站在第一章商人（无聊收集狂大叔）面前再开始，会直接砍价: Best to stand in front of the Chapter 1 merchant (无聊收集狂大叔) before starting; it then bargains right away
translations.按 {stop} 可随时停止，按键在设置里改: Press {stop} to stop at any time; the key is set in Settings
translations.消耗免费米饭和火把：米饭全部（MAX）打设定的地方，火把打圣石洞穴。: Uses free Cooked Rice and Torches: all rice (MAX) goes where you set it, torches go to the Sacred Stone Cave.
translations.只有金币航线双倍时，免费米饭全部打这里。: When only the Gold route is doubled, all free rice goes here.
translations.只有史莱姆航线双倍时，免费米饭全部打这里。: When only the Slime route is doubled, all free rice goes here.
translations.金币和史莱姆航线都双倍时，免费米饭全部打这里。: When both the Gold and Slime routes are doubled, all free rice goes here.
translations.快速狩猎有新设定: Quick Hunt has a new setting
translations.双倍时米饭打哪里，现在可以自己选，也能打狩猎场。设定在「任务设定」里。: You can now choose where rice goes on double days, Hunting Ground included. It's under "Task Setup".
translations.双倍时米饭打哪里: Where rice goes on double days
translations.每行选一个：金币、史莱姆或狩猎场，都用 MAX。已照你原本的设定开好，确认一下就: Pick one per row: Gold, Slime or Hunting Ground, always MAX. Already set to match your old settings, just check them.
translations.火把全部打这个属性的圣石洞穴；「最少」是每次自动挑目前最少的属性。: All torches go to this element's Magic Crystal Cave. "Lowest" picks whichever element you have the fewest of each time.
translations.火把打哪个属性的圣石，现在可以自己选。设定在「任务设定」里。: You can now choose which Magic Crystal element torches go to. It's under "Task Setup".
translations.默认还是「最少」，自动打目前最少的属性。想固定刷某个属性就点它。: Still "Lowest" by default: the element you have the fewest of. Tap an element to always farm that one.
translations.吸收、召集、压制之间隔几秒再按下一个。电脑或网络较慢、技能常常没按上时调大。: Seconds to wait between Absorb, Summon and Subdue. Raise it if your PC or network is slow and skills often don't register.
translations.吸收、召集、压制之间隔几秒，现在在「跑图」页就能改。: The seconds between Absorb, Summon and Subdue can now be changed on the Farming page.
translations.点这里调整，0.5 到 2 秒。电脑或网络较慢、技能常常没按上时调大。: Click here to change it, 0.5 to 2 s. Raise it if your PC or network is slow and skills often don't register.
translations.全部做完且没有失败后关闭游戏: Close the game when everything is done with no failure
translations.一键完成日常没有任何一项失败、且全部已启用子任务今日均已完成（含运行前就已完成的: Closes the game after Run All Dailies when no item failed and every enabled item is done today (including ones done before the run).
translations.做完后可以关闭游戏: The game can now close when done
translations.按「一键完成日常」后，确认视窗左下角可以勾「全部做完且没有失败后关闭游戏」。默认: After pressing "Run All Dailies", tick "Close the game when everything is done with no failure" at the bottom left of the confirm window. Off by default.
translations.全部做完了，照设定关闭了游戏: All done; the game was closed as set
translations.全部做完了，但游戏没能关掉，请自己关闭: All done, but the game could not be closed; please close it yourself
translations.主页 → 亲密度。LV20 的服装谈到 15/15，谈满后不再打开；未满 LV2: Home → Affinity. LV20 costumes are counseled up to 15/15 and never opened again once full; costumes below LV20 get the 3 daily counselings, answered from the answer list.
translations.「救赎之塔」和「亲密度谈心」加进一键完成日常了，会跟其他日常一起跑。: "Tower of Redemption" and "Affinity Counseling" are now part of Run All Dailies and run with the other dailies.
translations.每天到恶魔城的救赎之塔按快速战斗，次数选 MAX。不想跑就点它，关掉右边的「加入: Every day it goes to the Tower of Redemption in Evil Castle and uses Quick Battle at MAX. To skip it, click it and turn off "Add to Run All Dailies" on the right.
translations.每天在主页的亲密度和服装谈心，按题库选答案。不想跑就点它，关掉右边的「加入一键完: Every day it counsels costumes under Affinity on the home screen, picking answers from the answer list. To skip it, click it and turn off "Add to Run All Dailies" on the right.
translations.关掉就完全取消，Windows 里也不留: Turning it off cancels it completely, nothing is left in Windows
translations.点这里设定几点自动跑: Click to set when it runs by itself
translations.没有开着的时段，点这里设定: No time slot is on, click to set
translations.电脑睡着时叫不醒：Windows 不让打开唤醒定时器: Can't wake the PC from sleep: Windows won't turn on wake timers
translations.Windows 没有接受这个设定：{why}: Windows did not accept this setting: {why}
translations.每天 {time}，游戏重置后 {m} 分钟: Every day {time}, {m} min after the game reset
translations.只开关这个时段: Turn only this time slot on or off
translations.时间到自动打开游戏，跑今天还没做的: Opens the game at the set time and runs what is left today
translations.加回「游戏每天重置后」: Add back "After the daily game reset"
translations.睡眠中会被叫醒；完全关机的电脑叫不醒: A sleeping PC is woken; a PC that is shut down cannot be
translations.全部做完且没有失败时才会做；手动按开始也一样: Only when everything is done with no failure; also for runs you start yourself
translations.定时启动跑的那次，全部做完且没有失败时才会做: Only for runs Scheduled Start begins, when everything is done with no failure
translations.电脑停在锁屏画面，工具没办法操作游戏，这次没有跑。要让定时启动能跑，Window: The PC was at the lock screen, so the tool could not control the game and nothing ran. For Scheduled Start to work, Windows must not ask for a password after waking.
translations.一键日常没能开始（可能有别的任务正在跑），这次没有跑。: Run All Dailies could not start (another task may be running), so nothing ran.
translations.等了 {m} 分钟，游戏还是没打开或没登录进去，这次没有跑。: Waited {m} min but the game did not open or log in, so nothing ran.
translations.等了 {m} 分钟，工具一直在忙（有别的任务在跑），一键日常没能开始，这次没有跑: Waited {m} min but the tool stayed busy (another task was running), so Run All Dailies did not start and nothing ran.
translations.网络连不上 Server酱，看看电脑有没有连网: Can't reach Server酱. Check that the PC is online
translations.SendKey 不对，请重新复制贴上: The SendKey is wrong. Copy and paste it again
translations.SendKey 格式不对：要贴 SCT 开头的那一串: That's not a SendKey: paste the string that starts with SCT
translations.今天的免费次数用完了（每天 5 则），明天会恢复: Today's free messages are used up (5 a day). They come back tomorrow
translations.收到这则，跑完通知就设定好了。: If you got this, run notifications are set up.
translations.一键完成日常跑完，把结果发到你自己的微信: When Run All Dailies ends, send the results to your own WeChat
translations.点下面的按钮，打开 Server酱 网站: Click the button below to open the Server酱 site
translations.用微信扫码登录，照网页提示关注公众号: Scan the code with WeChat to log in, then follow the official account as the page says
translations.复制 SCT 开头的那一串 SendKey: Copy the SendKey that starts with SCT
translations.贴到下面，按「发测试」，微信收到就好了: Paste it below and press "Send test". Done once WeChat gets it
translations.只发完成几项、失败原因和用时，不发账号名称和电脑名称。免费版每天 5 则，一天跑: Only sends how many items were done, why any failed and how long it took; never account or PC names. Free plan: 5 a day; one run uses 1.
translations.一键完成日常跑完，可以把结果发到你自己的微信。默认关闭，设定在「设置」里。: When Run All Dailies ends, the results can be sent to your own WeChat. Off by default; it's in Settings.
translations.打开右边的开关，照着步骤用微信扫码拿到 SendKey，贴上就好。: Turn on the switch at the right, follow the steps to get a SendKey by scanning with WeChat, and paste it.
translations.登录卡住了，游戏一直没进到主页，一键日常没有开始跑。请看一下游戏画面: Login is stuck: the game never reached the home screen, so Run All Dailies did not start. Please check the game screen
translations.可以定时自动跑日常: Dailies can now run on a schedule
translations.在首页设定几点，时间到了就自动跑一键完成日常，工具没开也会自己打开。默认关闭，点: Set the times on Home and Run All Dailies starts on its own at those times, opening the tool if it is closed. Off by default; click this card to set it up.
translations.没选星期，这个时段不会跑: No day picked: this slot will not run
translations.和另一个时段隔不到 1 小时，请错开: Less than 1 hour from another slot; move one of them
translations.电脑完全关机时不会启动；睡眠中可以叫醒: Does not start while the PC is shut down; a sleeping PC can be woken
translations.一键完成日常跑完后关闭游戏。: Closes the game after Run All Dailies ends.
translations.全部成功才关：没有任何一项跑失败、且全部已启用子任务今日均已完成才关。跑失败也关: Only if all succeed: closes only when no item failed and every enabled item is done today. Even if something fails: closes when the run ends, also when an item failed or the run stopped on an error.
translations.跑完了（有几项失败），照设定关闭了游戏: Run ended (some items failed); the game was closed as set
translations.跑完了，但游戏没能关掉，请自己关闭: Run ended, but the game could not be closed; please close it yourself
translations.定时启动跑的那次做完才会做，什么时候关照一键日常的设定: Only for runs Scheduled Start begins; when to close follows the Run All Dailies setting
translations.按「一键完成日常」后，确认视窗左下角可以勾「做完关闭游戏」，再选什么时候关。默认: After pressing "Run All Dailies", tick "Close the game when done" at the bottom left of the confirm window, then pick when to close. Off by default.
translations.{names} 会在游戏画面上画字或改帧数，可能让工具认错画面而失败。: {names} draws on the game screen or changes its frames, so the tool may misread a screen and fail.
translations.跑之前关掉它最稳: Closing it before the run is safest
translations.当时开着 FPS 工具（{names}），可能让工具认错画面，关掉再跑试试: An FPS tool was open ({names}); it may have made the tool misread the screen. Close it and run again.

「只刷普通难度」改成默认不勾，挑战战斗会推到你选的最高关卡。设定在「任务设定」里: "Normal only" is now off by default, so Challenge pushes up to the highest stage you pick. It's under "Task Setup".
「只刷普通难度」已关掉，想只打普通战斗再打开。「挑战战斗最高关卡」可选第5、10: "Normal only" is now off; turn it on if you only want Normal. "Challenge highest stage" can be 5, 10 or 15; once reached, leftover AP quick-battles that stage.
